articleTitle: An Introduction of CNN: Models and Training on Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, practitioners of computer-related industries pay more attention to the neural network. The excellent predictive ability makes neural network models stand out and almost fill every corner of the network. The convolutional neural network is one of the neural network models. Compared with other models, the convolutional neural network has more advantages in image recognition and segmentation technology due to its unique layer types. Research on convolutional neural networks started in the 1980s and 1990s. In the 21st century, convolutional neural networks have developed rapidly. The theory of deep learning and the improvement of numerical computing equipment make great progress in computer vision, natural language processing and other fields.

articleTitle: Research on data security governance based on artificial intelligence technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Artificial intelligence data security governance has become a major proposition in the process of artificial intelligence development. At present, AI data governance in China is characterized by “collaborative governance” and “governance scenario”, with multiple parties participating and multiple approaches working together. Based on the analysis of the current situation of AI data security governance, this paper focuses on the analysis of AI data security governance risks and technical solution strategies based on the requirements of the technology itself, aiming to contribute new methods and new ideas to the research of data security governance. And it is pointed out that: Coping with the risk can start from the AI data governance concept and ideas, and establish the AI data application governance system, so as to promote the promotion of AI data scenario-based governance.

articleTitle: The Water Potability Prediction Based on Active Support Vector Machine and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: The total amount of water on the planet is approximately 1.4 billion cubic kilometers, but only 2.5% of it is fresh water. Among freshwater resources, human drinkable water resources account for only 0.3 % of them. In Africa, hundreds of thousands of people fall ill or even die from drinking unclean water every year. If the water potability can be predicted accurately, then it can save a lot of the human, material and financial resources of the country and the region on the drinkability of water resources, which is an important step for the application of machine learning in water resources monitoring. In the technology field, today's machine learning technology has become mature, and it has been applied in many fields such as finance, biology, and medical care. The algorithms in machine learning can be used to help humans quickly identify whether water can be drunk so that the efficiency of identifying water availability is greatly improved. Among the many machine learning methods, artificial neural networks and support vector machine algorithms became popular in machine learning due to their large processing data and fast calculation speed. Therefore, selecting the above two algorithms to judge the drinking ability of water resources is expected to better achieve the desired purpose. In conclusion, after constant tuning of parameters and changing the calculation mode, a high-precision artificial neural network model and SVM prediction model were obtained, which make judgments in an extremely efficient manner and predictions highly accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Security and Privacy Risk Governance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In the era of Big Data, opportunities and challenges are mixed. The data transfer is increasingly frequent and speedy, and the data lifecycle is also extended, bringing more challenges to security and privacy risk governance. Currently, the common measures of risk governance covering the entire data life cycle are the data-related staff management, equipment security management, data encryption codes, data content identification and de-identification processing, etc. With the trend of data globalization, regulations fragmentation and governance technologization, “International standards”, a measure of governance combining technology and regulation, has the potential to become the best practice. However, “voluntary compliance” of international standards derogates the effectiveness of risk governance through this measure. In order to strengthen the enforcement of the international standards, the paper proposes a governance approach which is “the framework regulated by international standards, and regulations and technologies specifically implemented by national legislation.” It aims to implement the security and privacy risk governance of Big Data effectively.

articleTitle: Application of big data acquisition and analysis technology in social risk management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: At present, risks and challenges are related to the country's social development. The collection and analysis technology of big data has opened up a new path for social risk management. Big data technology provides powerful data information, tool capabilities and technical platform support for social risk governance. With the application of big data collection and analysis technology, the subject participation governance model has been tried, the traditional social governance model has changed, and the social risk governance has become more scientific. In the new era, social risk management should be promoted by big data acquisition and analysis technology. It is necessary to cultivate big data thinking and change the thinking paradigm of social risk management; Optimizing the institutional system and coordinating the effectiveness of social risk management; Actively participate in various parties to realize diversified and coordinated governance of social risks.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Isolation Forest and LOF algorithm in anomaly detection of data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: [Purpose] In the research of data mining, anomaly detection algorithms can accurately find samples of abnormal behaviors to achieve the purpose of data mining. the isolation forest algorithm and the LOF algorithm play an important role as the classic representatives of anomaly detection algorithms, but which algorithm is more suitable for processing massive amounts of data is a constant concern. [Method] Select the isolation forest algorithm and the LOF algorithm. Firstly, analyze the principle and process of the two algorithms; then use the two algorithms to conduct experimental simulations through the data set to compare and study the accuracy and stability of the two algorithms in data anomaly detection. [Conclusion] The experimental data shows that the isolation forest algorithm is more suitable for anomaly detection in data mining; at the same time, improvements are proposed for the shortcomings of the isolation forest algorithm.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Quality Evaluation based on Human Visual System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: With increasing attention to underwater observation and utilization of marine resources, people's demand for underwater vision continues to increase. The processing of underwater images has received more and more attention. Underwater image quality evaluation plays a crucial role in underwater image processing technology and is also an important standard for underwater image enhancement. In this paper, we proposed a new no-reference underwater image quality evaluation method, which selects three indexes related to the human visual system: chroma, definition, and contrast. The chroma is calculated by saturation and the ratio of red channels to green and blue channels; the definition is calculated through the maximum gradient value and the detail content of the image; the contrast is calculated by the standard deviation of the image pixel value. The new underwater image evaluation index uses a linear combination of three attribute values. Experimental results show that this method can effectively evaluate the quality of underwater images based on the perception of human eyes.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network for Image Classification Based on Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Satellite image classification is a meaningful task, such as helping recognize the damaged houses. Traditional methods like ANN and BoW are not good at satellite image classification. CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) has been generally used to do image classification, and it can be applied to many daily situations like damage assessment. In this paper, we build a CNN model and discuss its advantage over other present models. Besides, to increase the robustness of our model, we add image enhancement to our training data. The preliminary model can reach an accuracy of 0.9706 in our experiment.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Damage of Houses hit by the hurricane based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: The world is confronting multiple huge hurricanes every year, and people are suffering. So, it is necessary to design a scheme to save as many as people possible during the catastrophe. In this paper, we will introduce a CNN neuron model to identify a set of pictures to types of before the hurricane and after the hurricane. Then, we need to experiment with the drop-out layer and image augmentation to refine the model. First, we compare the accuracy under three situations (with drop-out layer, strengthen the data, and none). Then we work out the best way of training the data. We finally got the classification accurate with 96.97% in number.

articleTitle: Innovative application of big data technology in digital music copyright protection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: The current rapid development of science and technology has brought new development prospects for the innovation of big data technology. In the protection of digital music copyright, big data technology uses the exclusive music copyright platform to carry out innovative protection of music copyright in terms of storage technology, and analyzes the basic situation of digital music copyright on the Internet through data. Digital music copyright uses big data and copyright cloud to establish a digital music copyright protection system, which greatly promotes the innovative development of digital music copyright in China. Copyright cloud mainly stores a large amount of music data into the music system, and uses model statistics, data analysis, data mining and other technologies to analyze and study the information. By establishing a big data research-based learning platform based on digital music copyright protection, build a modern music copyright professional system. Based on the big data network, through the copyright cloud, it is verified that the data prediction under the big data technology has good analytical ability and data processing ability.

articleTitle: Research on the path of college students' self-education in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: The era of big data is an era of high-speed information exchange and processing, openness of information, and personalized information acquisition. Faced with the continuous emergence of massive amounts of data and information in the era of big data, it has brought risks and challenges to the self-education of college students. The massive amount of information in the era of big data makes the content of college students' self-education more abundant, and the openness of the era of big data improves the subjectivity of college students' self-education. The risk challenges of the era of big data put forward higher requirements for college students' self-education ability. therefore, it is necessary to improve college students' self-education ability from the perspective of creating a high-quality big data environment and optimizing the social environment in the era of big data.

articleTitle: A Proposed Customer Connection System model for Dentsu International. Ltd
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Dentsu International (previously Dentsu Aegis) was held by Japanese media organization Dentsu, with the head office in London. It merged more than ten influential advertising brands accountable for different businesses (e.g. Merkie, Amplifi, Carat, Amnet). The company provides media planning and marketing analysis services to clients based on the digital executive. Customer Connection System (CCS) is one of the most distinctive organizational mechanisms in Densu International, which is applied to integrate data and conduct research. In this paper, a proposed CCS model has been investigated in three facets, requirements analysis, traditional models, and soft analysis.

articleTitle: Risk management in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: As the reform enters the deep water zone, various contradictions are increasingly revealed, various risk events continue to appear, and risk governance faces new challenges. As the product of informationization development, big data has a series of new characteristics and provides a new idea and technical support for risk management. To promote the innovative path of risk management in the era of big data, we should cultivate big data technology thinking and change traditional thinking of risk management, apply big data platforms systems to realize networked governance, strengthen the construction of governance systems to ensure governance effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on the Connection between Supply and Demand of Accounting Talents in Higher Vocational Colleges under the Background of “Big Data + Artificial Intelligence”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In the era of “big data + artificial intelligence”, accounting work has changed, showing the characteristics of cloud accounting, intelligence, socialization, industrialization, process, standardization, systematization and specialization. As the supply side of accounting talents, higher vocational colleges are also actively exploring teaching resources, teaching methods and talent training modes to adapt to the new era, new technology and new business forms. This paper analyzes the demand sides and supply side changes of accounting talents for the era of “big data + artificial intelligence”, and puts forward the thinking of coordination between the supply and demand of accounting talents.

articleTitle: Integrated Risk Analysis Rely on Multi-data for Flash Flood in China Considering the Sensitivity of Disaster-prone Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In recent years, flash flood have become the main kind of disaster causing death in China and even in the world, which has brought huge casualties and economic losses. On the basis of discussing the principles and methods of flash flood risk analysis, the long-term risk of flash flood in China was quantitatively calculated. For acquiring and utilizing multiple data, dividing the region of China into 90m × 90m grids. Then the hazard value of flood-causing factors, the sensitivity value of disaster-prone environment and the vulnerability value of disaster-bearing bodies in rainstorm-type mountainous areas were calculated for each grid, and then the risk distribution map of flash flood disaster in China was obtained by synthesizing them.

articleTitle: Research on the formation path and countermeasures of big data “killing” phenomenon from the perspective of information transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In the case of information symmetry, the behavior of both sides of information transmission is relatively transparent and can be observed. However, in reality, information asymmetry is common and difficult to eliminate. While the popularization of e-commerce makes people's life more convenient, the phenomenon of big data killing that damages the interests of consumers appears. Meanwhile, service providers may conduct risky behaviors in violation of morality though causing private security risks of information subjects. Given this phenomenon, we create a model from the perspective of information transmission to analyze the transaction process between merchants and consumers. Then we conclude the algorithm killing reasons as follows, users of consumer inertia and asymmetric information-related legal regulations are lack standardization. Last we put forward some countermeasures: improve consumer privacy protection and rights protection consciousness, strengthen enterprise internal moral construction and industry standardization construction, improve laws and regulations and play the role of government supervision.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Learners' Trust and Privacy Concerns on the Willingness to Use Online Learning Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: [Purpose/Meaning] Online learning has become an indispensable part of learners' lives. In order to meet the needs of learners for personalized learning and lifelong learning, various learning platforms appeared. From the perspective of privacy protection, this article provides some methods to online learning platforms, which can make them attract more users and increase their stickiness. [Methods/Processes] This paper combines the theory of privacy computing to construct a conceptual model of the influence of learners' privacy concerns and trust on their willingness to adopt online learning platforms. Based on the data of the questionnaires, this article uses the structural equation model to conduct empirical research on the proposed assumptions and models. [Results/Conclusions] The research shows that: privacy awareness and perceived risk have the positive influence on privacy; trust and perceived benefits have the positive influence on the willingness to adopt online learning platforms.

articleTitle: A Brief Analysis of Using Big Data Technology to Analyze the Impact of Ownership Structure on Company's Operating Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Nowadays, in the era of big data, intelligent technology has played an important role in various fields. This paper uses Xinjiang listed companies from 2012–2017 as a research sample to explore how big data on the equity structure of Xinjiang listed companies can play a role in operating performance. Through the use of relevant descriptive statistics and measurement methods, the company's equity structure is divided into three aspects: equity concentration, equity checks and balances and equity liquidity, and the company's operating performance is measured by the return on net assets. The study found that the concentration of equity has a positive impact on the company's operating performance. However, the degree of equity checks and balances and equity liquidity have a significant negative correlation with the company's operating performance. On this basis, combined with the background of big data, further analysis of the impact of the ownership structure on the company's operating performance is carried out. Finally, combined with the actual situation from the perspective of improving the company's operating performance, several measures to strengthen the governance of the equity structure under the background of big data are proposed to improve the company's operating performance.

articleTitle: Design and application of real estate market monitoring platform based on spatio-temporal big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: When the traditional visualization application platform visually analyzes large-scale real estate spatio-temporal data, there are problems such as slow loading and poor functional scalability. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a design scheme of a visual analysis platform for real estate market monitoring. First, carry out conceptual analysis and feature induction of spatio-temporal big data to realize the collection processing and organizational structure analysis of real estate spatio-temporal big data. Then a four-tier platform architecture consisting of data sources layer, data resource management layer, interface service engine layer and visual application layer is designed. The visualization platform designed by this scheme has good scalability, and can provide technical guidance for the construction of a visualization analysis platform in the field of industry spatio-temporal big data. Finally, a visual application design is carried out based on the real estate market data of Hubei Province, which proves the validity and feasibility of the research scheme in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Novel Clustering Algorithm Based on Convolutional Variational Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In this era of rapid technological development, the information that people come into contact with has increased exponentially. Every corner of human society has accumulated a variety of data. In this context. how to organize and utilize unlabeled data effectively becomes an urgent problem to be solved. This has promoted the development of a research hotspot in artificial intelligence, clustering. Recently, clustering algorithm based on auto-encoders have attracted widespread attention because of their excellent performance. However, when the data dimension is very high and its structure is relatively complex especially facing image data, the clustering method based on auto-encoder cannot get satisfactory clustering results. Meanwhile, these methods also have the disadvantage of not being able to directly learn the clustering results. To address the above issues this paper proposes a clustering algorithm based on the convolutional variational auto-encoder called Conv-VAE. Through the joint optimization learning of convolutional network and variational auto-encoder, the method can better process high-dimensional image data. The category-encoder embedded in the network can directly obtain the clustering results, avoiding complicated post-processing. Experiments on real image data sets demonstrate that our proposed algorithm is superior to related algorithms proposed in recent years in terms of clustering performance.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Image Analysis and Processing Technology in Basketball in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: With the continuous progress of the Internet, big data technology is more and more widely used in an era when data is growing exponentially every day. Now all industries are trying to use big data technology for production and operation in order to improve efficiency, and the basketball industry is no exception. The emergence of digital image analysis and processing technology has brought a great impact to the field of basketball. The images of basketball players during competition or training are obtained by using high-speed cameras or varistors. After the data processing of shooting hot zone distribution, singles success rate and other applications of statistical principles and data analysis technology, they are presented to coaches and athletes to scientifically improve the technical level of players. At the same time, digital image processing technology can also be used in the judgment of basketball examination or basketball game results. The background modeling algorithm based on pixel frequency and three frame difference algorithm are used to detect basketball targets, realize the judgment of basketball goals, and improve the accuracy and objectivity of basketball examination or basketball game results.

articleTitle: Data Asset Operation System of Electric Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Data asset operation is the key and core of building data factor market. It has become the core work of global data development. As an important force in energy transformation and digital transformation, power enterprises must actively carry out the construction of power data asset operation system. Power enterprises need to build a data asset operation system composed of six key tasks: data ownership and compliance application, data asset value evaluation, data asset price accounting, data asset circulation strategy, data asset income distribution and data operation effectiveness evaluation. Define the operation boundary of data assets, use the index system to evaluate the value of data assets, and use the mathematical model to calculate the price of data assets. Promote and apply relevant technical methods to achieve the purpose of quantitative management and scientific decision-making.

articleTitle: Multi-target tracking method based on FCM clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In order to accurately estimate the target number of the probability hypothesis density (PHD) filter, this paper proposes a cardinality compensation method based on fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering. In the actual application of PHD filter tracking, when the noise and clutter in the measurement are high, the tracking loss will occur. For this reason, the measurement cardinality is obtained through data clustering. In order to verify the performance of the proposed method, simulations are carried out, and it is proved that the tracking performance of multiple targets has been improved, and the base estimation is more accurate.

articleTitle: A Decision Support Method for Interdisciplinary Major in Colleges and Universities Based on Natural Language Processing and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, many disciplines reveal the general trends of crossing and blending, and new interdisciplinary subjects emerge. For decision makers in colleges and universities, it is crucial and difficult to choose and construct a proper interdisciplinary major. In the paper we simulate the phenomenon of current conduction to improve natural language processing and data mining. An assistant decision-making method of setting up interdisciplinary majors for colleges and universities is designed, which could not only intelligently and automatically recommend the most suitable interdisciplinary majors, but also simplify and correct the work of decision-makers. Our experimental analysis demonstrates that similarity ratio of interdisciplinary majors recommended by the proposed assistant decision-making method runs at more than 70 percent compared with manual recommendation of specialists.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Ontology Knowledge System for Internet Financial Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In the context of the Internet era, how to effectively express and store Internet financial risk information is a problem that needs to be solved urgently. With the maturity of information technology, the use of ontology technology to build an Internet financial risk management ontology knowledge system model can effectively solve this problem. First of all, confirm the scope of the Internet financial risk management ontology knowledge system. Then, by communicating with domain experts, construct the ontology knowledge system model of Internet financial risk management. Finally, use knowledge acquisition to fill the Internet financial risk management ontology knowledge system model, including the definition of the categories and concepts, the relationship between the concepts and so on. The ontology knowledge system model provides a basis for knowledge expression and knowledge sharing of Internet financial risk information, thereby effectively satisfying Internet financial risk management decision support and improving the efficiency of Internet risk management.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in the On-site Decision System of Sports Competitions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence technology is deepening and expanding, and many industries begin to use artificial intelligence technology to improve efficiency and accuracy. Artificial intelligence technology is more and more widely used in the field of sports. Machine vision, infrared technology, electronic induction technology and computer control technology in artificial intelligence can play a role in all aspects of the field of sports. Unlike other computer technologies, artificial intelligence can imitate the human brain for decision-making. Neural networks in artificial intelligence technology can reason based on Hebb rules and a large number of factual data. Moreover, the genetic algorithm in artificial intelligence can be continuously improved based on the coding of individuals in the population and the determination of fitness function, and the decision-making can be more and more accurate. The ability of artificial intelligence to make decisions can bring a new situation to sports competition. The fairness of sports competition will be improved because of artificial intelligence technology, and each team can make decisions according to the strategy analyzed by artificial intelligence technology.

articleTitle: Fixed-Asset Investment and Three Strata of Industry Based on Clustering Analysis and Granger Causality Test
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: In order to accelerate the transformation and upgrading of the domestic industrial structure and accelerate the transformation of the economic structure from export-oriented to investment-oriented, investment in fixed assets has become an integral part of promoting economic development. This article mainly uses cluster analysis to confirm the compatibility of the three levels of industry classification with the data from China Statistical Yearbook. Through Stata, we use the VAR model and the linear Granger causality test to study the lagging effects of fixed asset investment and China's three major industries.

articleTitle: Optimizing CNN for classifying buildings post hurricane
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: CNN models are commonly used in all kinds of fields every day because of their powerful classification abilities. For example, we use the CNN models to classify whether the buildings are damaged post hurricane. In this way, people can easily calculate the loss of society caused by the hurricane. And it can help society to rescue the people in need because of the disaster by identifying the damaged houses. However, running the model, I find there is an overfitting problem to the model due to the randomly designed structure. Therefore, I change the structure by reducing the model's nodes and layers and comparing the result I get. Then I find that the overfitting problem remains unsolved, which shows that the CNN model does not depend on its classification ability of the model on how the nodes and layers of the model are designed.

articleTitle: Research progress of artificial intelligence in the diagnosis of fatty liver
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: As a chronic disease, early intervention is more effective against nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, but its early symptoms are not apparent, so it is difficult to detect. As the technology of artificial intelligence was developed, this problem is expected to be solved. This paper reviews the application of artificial intelligence in the examination of non-alcoholic fatty liver, providing a new idea about the health management of non-alcoholic fatty liver in modern Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of the Music Influence and Evolution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Based on big data analysis, we study the comprehensive indicators that measure the influence and revolution of music products, try to provide relative music standards for social to analyze its popular trend. In this paper, we introduce the Decision Tree, Lasso regression model, construct music innovation indicators based on Dijkstra shortest path algorithms, and describe improved models for quantifying music tendency, exploring relevance of genre indicators to brand influence. Also, to target the strategic research of cultural music products and measure the profitability of cultural companies in the field of big data, this paper commits to contribute theoretical support for related companies and departments.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Resource Conflicts Identification of the Automated Terminal Equipment Based on An Improved Fuzzy Clustering Method and Matter Element Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: To identify the resource conflicts of the automated terminal equipment, to better manage the automatic terminal equipment resource allocation. Taking Xiamen Ocean Gate Container Terminal as the research object, the improved fuzzy clustering algorithm is applied to perform cluster analysis on the operation data of the automated terminal, and the classification results of the conflicting factors affecting the automated terminal equipment are obtained. The classification result is used to construct the entropy weight matter element model to identify the terminal resource conflict. The example verifies that the resource conflict curve of the automated terminal equipment presents a “V” -shaped characteristic. Various conflicting factors cross each other, and the resource conflict of the terminal operation is relatively significant.

articleTitle: Value Analysis Method of Distribution Center for Resource- based Collaborative Distribution Based on Social Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: At present, the partner selection of collaborative distribution alliances is not reasonable, and the benefit allocation of collaborative distribution alliances is not fair and just. This paper proposes a value analysis method based on social network and operation data to identify the influential values of each Distribution Center (DC) in the collaborative distribution alliance that defines a fair collaborative mechanism. Firstly, the initial social networks between each DC, their customers and goods are set up by Ucinet according to their distribution relationships indicated by the operation data. Then the initial social networks are transformed to the dual competition and cooperation network models, namely, the 2-mode network of DCs and customers and the 2-mode network of DCs and goods types. Based on the dual competition and cooperation models, the characteristics analysis indicators on the overall and individual structure of the models are designed to identify the status and value difference of each DC in the collaborative distribution alliance, such that define fair collaborative operation mechanism. A case study of 60 distribution centers in Nanning city was carried out to test the method. It is proved that the method provides theoretical support for resource-oriented cooperative distribution alliance partner selection, power and benefit distribution.

articleTitle: The Situational Factors and Influencing Paths of Residents' Perception of Risks in NIMBY Facilities Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: Situational factors are important system control variables in NIMBY (not-in-my- backyard) conflicts. In this article, firstly based on theoretical analysis, design a questionnaire on the influencing factors of residents' risk perception, survey the residents in the communities near typical engineering facilities, and obtain sample data. Next, using exploratory factor analysis, with a characteristic value of 0.8 as the standard, the four main situational factors of political governance and communication, information media, public awareness and economic benefits are extracted, and the cumulative explanation variance contribution rate is 71.133%. Then, construct a structural equation model and analyze the influencing path of the four main situational factors on residents' risk perception by observing 19 variables. The results show that political governance and communication, and information media have a significant negative impact on residents' perception of risks in NIMBY facilities; but public awareness and economic benefits have a significant positive impact on residents' risk perception. In order to effectively reduce the risk of NIMBY facilities, government departments should improve the risk communication and public participation mechanisms for the construction of surrounding risk avoidance facilities, strengthen the supervision of the information dissemination environment, guide residents to legally protect their rights, and balance the risks and benefits of residents.

Index Terms: Not In My Back Yard Facility

articleTitle: Visual Analysis on Chinese Smart Library Researches based on Citespace
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: The paper uses the bibliometric method to conduct visual analysis on Chinese smart library researches, presenting research status-quo, hot-spots, and trend by a data visualization software called Citespace. Taking 1938 Chinese journal papers from 1993 to 2020 of CNKI.net as data source, the authors select publication time and keywords to analyze the time distribution characteristics, keywords co-occurrence, clustering, and burst terms of these papers by Citespace. It is found that the volume of papers is in a state of rational and continuous development. The hot-spots focus on library construction, information technology, user smart service, and “smart” fields. The research on Chinese smart libraries has blossomed in many aspects. The research has its innovation, and its trend is flexibly adjusted to the background of the times and the development of national strategies.

articleTitle: The adoption and deployment of cloud computing: a comparative study between China and the US
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management (ICBAR)
abstract: At the beginning of this article reviewed the related literature about cloud computing technology, and then use the PEST method, from the political, economic, social, technology, four aspects, comparing the similarities and differences between the two countries in the field of cloud computing, and starting from the trend of investment and technology, the two countries at present and the future market development to make analysis, summed up the experience of cloud computing technology, Suggest feasible solutions to the problems in the development of China's cloud computing industry. Then, through the analysis of the background and development of cloud Guizhou, Oracle and TikTok, this paper points out the common security problems faced by the cloud computing industry in China and the United States. Finally, this paper discussed three ideas about combining cloud computing and 5G, the future of cloud computing, and the security part of cloud computing.
